title: GateKeychainResult
description: Internal reply from the gate's fixed Security.framework helper. OSStatus only; errors contain no native text or credential values.

unlock.description: The outcome of an unlock request: unlocked with auto-lock off, or still locked because the passphrase was rejected. Absent on every other request and on any other failure.

locked.description: Present on a failed item request when the keychain reported itself locked (its unlocked status bit clear). Absent on success and on every other failure.
